## Checklist

Tick what applies. A documentation or typo fix only needs the first box — leave
the rest unticked rather than deleting them.

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-your-commits-dco)
- [ ] New behaviour has a test in `crates/bubbles-dialogue/tests/`
- [ ] New public items have doc comments
- [ ] User-visible changes have a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] CI is green

Draft pull requests are welcome if you want feedback before this is finished.
